defects.title: Hardcoded output_frames == source_frames duration lock prevented intelligent pacing cuts
defects.baseline_evidence: motionlab/composition/r5_engine.py and motionlab/pipeline.py unconditionally enforced out_frames == media.duration_frames (720f).
defects.fix_summary: Branched validation strictly by EditTimeMap mode: `--pacing preserve` enforces exact source frame count (720f); `--pacing auto` enforces exact independently validated EditTimeMap.output_total_frames (never derived from final MP4) plus edit_time_map_valid, word_preservation_ok, and audio_joins_ok.
defects.measured_outcome: Canonical `--pacing auto` passes TECHNICAL_PASS at 630f (26.250s); legacy `--pacing preserve` regression passes TECHNICAL_PASS at exact 720f (30.000s); forged map/frame-count negative tests fail closed.

defects.title: No local speech/action pause perception or causal pacing director
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R3 could only layer graphics over full 30s timeline and had no VAD, pause taxonomy, or cut planner.
defects.fix_summary: Implemented offline chunked Silero VAD ONNX (`faster_whisper.vad`) + 20ms spectral cross-check + consonant-tail alignment (`motionlab/semantic/speech_perception.py`) and multi-niche causal pacing director with 4 competing plans (`identity`/`conservative`/`balanced`/`tight`) (`motionlab/semantic/pacing_director.py`).
defects.measured_outcome: Real Olivia run auto-selected `pacing_balanced` (score 77.0 vs identity 33.62): 3 safe cuts removing 3.750s (`720 -> 630f`, `26.250s`), `70/70` words preserved (`token_recall=1.0`, `re_asr_status=EXECUTED:OK`). Causal candidate score reversal test proves EditTimeMap & output_total_frames change causally.

defects.title: Timestamp alignment honesty and segment-only / VAD-disagreement safety
defects.baseline_evidence: Segment-only transcripts risked unsafe mid-word cuts and approximate ASR timestamps lacked explicit uncertainty bounds.
defects.fix_summary: Enforced honest alignment labeling (`VAD_ENVELOPE_REFINED` / `ASR_WORD_ESTIMATE` / `SEGMENT_APPROX`, `forced_aligner_used=false`, `sample_exact_ground_truth=false`), whole-segment protection on `SEGMENT_APPROX`, 5ms RMS consonant-tail extension, and automatic cut abstention (`AMBIGUOUS`) on VAD-spectral disagreement or silent videos.
defects.measured_outcome: Olivia alignment honestly labeled `VAD_ENVELOPE_REFINED` (`forced_aligner_used=false`, `mean_uncertainty_ms=49.0`, `vad_confirmed_ratio=1.0`, `60` consonant-tail extensions); silent-video & uncertain-VAD negative tests abstain with 0 cuts.

defects.title: R5.R3 live LLM eval harness marked reconciled_passed via bool(sb.storyboard_hash) instead of independent semantic oracle
defects.baseline_evidence: motionlab/semantic/eval_harness.py previously counted non-empty storyboard_hash as pass even if niche was wrong (e.g. raw Qwen2.5-3B mislabeling education/gameplay as finance/product).
defects.fix_summary: Implemented independent `evaluate_storyboard_semantics()` checking niche semantics, factual ledger, forbidden finance primitives, and UI/HUD protection; reconciled structural niche in `generative_director.py`; expanded deterministic multi-niche fixtures from 36 to 44 cases across 14 niches.
defects.measured_outcome: Mutation test (valid hash + wrong niche) fails closed; 44/44 deterministic eval PASS; 6-case live Qwen2.5-3B eval honestly reports raw_niche=2/6 and independently oracled reconciled_semantic=6/6.

defects.title: Exact rational source<->edited timeline clock, audio bed joins, and original master immutability
defects.baseline_evidence: No EditTimeMap, no Strategy-A frame-exact mezzanine, no sample-exact crossfaded edited voice bed, and no audio join click/drift QA existed.
defects.fix_summary: Implemented immutable `EditTimeMap` with exact `Fraction` rational sample allocation (24/1, 24000/1001, 30000/1001), Strategy-A CRF-10 frame-exact mezzanine, 12ms equal-power cosine micro-crossfade `build_edited_voice_bed()`, bit-exact original stream copy to `original_audio_master.m4a`, and `evaluate_audio_joins()` click/DC/drift QA.
defects.measured_outcome: Canonical Olivia: `actual_samples == expected_samples == 1,157,625` (`sample_count_diff=0`), `0` clicks, `0` DC jumps, `original_audio_master.m4a` bit-exact stream-copied, `13/13` SFX cues pass floor-free counterfactual ablation (`-15.2 LUFS`, `-1.2 dBTP`).

defects.title: Center-based {cx, cy, w, h} ROI track schema mismatch in visual critic, cut continuity, and action evidence
defects.baseline_evidence: Real roi_tracks.json uses {cx, cy, w, h} while visual_critic.py:383, edit_continuity.py:179, and speech_perception.py:690 expected {x, y, w, h}, causing KeyError 'x' in cut continuity and false +58.9 luma washout over top-card y=0.15 on sc_04.
defects.fix_summary: Normalized both {x, y, w, h} and {cx, cy, w, h} boxes cleanly across `edit_continuity.py`, `speech_perception.py`, and `visual_critic.py`.
defects.measured_outcome: Real Olivia objective pixel critic measures true face box (`max_face_washout_luma_delta=5.89`, `0` findings, `PASS`), cut continuity measures true face displacement (`<=0.0344`, `0` severe jumps, `PASS`), and pause task motion reflects true hand/table ROI.

defects.title: Short allocation beat (~1.4s Groceries) jarring aspect_morph flip and floating token overlap on progress stat caption
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R3 used aspect_morph_editorial cutaway on a 1.4s allocation beat; hf_mk_progress_stat spawned bill tokens at y_top+170 (z=2) overlapping '$400/$200 left to spend'.
defects.fix_summary: Biased short allocation beats (<2.1s) in `narrative_brain.py` toward continuous live editorial rail (`live_clean_bridge`); moved `.alloc-note` below card bottom edge (`y_top+216`, `z=1`) behind `#mk-ps-group` (`z=3`) in `primitive_adapters.py`.
defects.measured_outcome: Visual inspection of `scene_peaks_phone_scale.jpg` confirms sc_04 (`-$200 GROCERIES`, `1.458s`) stays smoothly in `live_clean_bridge` with crisp overlap-free typography across all 3 allocation cards.

defects.title: Warm-run matte cache misses and edited-domain cache key isolation
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R3 had 7/9 warm matte cache misses and did not key caches by EditTimeMap hash.
defects.fix_summary: Added content-addressed edited mezzanine and MODNet fg_alpha WebM caches plus `edit_map_hash` in Remotion/HF scene cache keys in `r5_engine.py`.
defects.measured_outcome: Warm w=2 run achieves `9/9` Remotion scene cache hits, `9/9` HF overlay cache hits, bundle reused (`0.001s`), and `2.52x` speedup (`305.1s` cold -> `121.2s` warm).

defects.title: Dense-speech noise-floor inversion in rhythm critic post-edit pause detector
defects.baseline_evidence: On dense edited speech beds with <15% silence, percentile(15) landed inside active speech (-18 dBFS), inflating threshold and falsely reporting 9.0s non-speech.
defects.fix_summary: Capped noise floor estimator at `min(percentile(10), -34.0)` and speech threshold at `min(-26.0, max(nf_db+9.0, -40.0))` in `visual_critic.py::run_rhythm_critic`.
defects.measured_outcome: Canonical edited voice bed accurately measures `longest_remaining_non_speech_s=0.62s`, `post_edit_non_speech_ratio=0.2127`, `objective_rhythm_status=PASS`.

defects.title: QA-02 Windows path scrubber previously corrupted https:// repo URL and lacked redacted pacing artifacts
defects.baseline_evidence: qa_pack.py `_WIN_ABS_RE` matched `s:/` inside `https://` and omitted pacing/cut/rhythm artifacts.
defects.fix_summary: Fixed `_WIN_ABS_RE` to exclude URL schemes (`(?<![A-Za-z0-9+.-])`) and added redacted `edit_time_map.json`, `pacing_decisions.json`, `word_preservation.json`, `cut_continuity.json`, `join_audio_qa.json`, `rhythm_critic.json`, and `pacing_summary`.
defects.measured_outcome: QA-02 manifest preserves `https://github.com/quocan050302/MotionLab-Studio`, scrubs all local absolute paths and private text, stays well under 2 MiB.

defects.title: Optional local model/VLM/real-heldout/real-longform/product-asset provisioning boundaries
defects.baseline_evidence: Host has 14 GiB free disk, Qwen2.5-3B text-only GGUF, no local VLM, no real product screenshots, and no owner-provided unrelated heldout or 5-min real videos.
defects.fix_summary: Maintained strict radical honesty without silent downloads or synthetic substitutions: explicit status tags `VISION_CRITIC_NOT_RUN`, `MODEL_UPGRADE_NOT_RUN`, `ASSET_MISSING_CONCEPTUAL`, `REAL_HELDOUT_NOT_RUN`, `REAL_LONGFORM_NOT_RUN`, `LISTENING_NOT_RUN_AUTOMATED_PROXY_ONLY`, `PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW`.
defects.measured_outcome: All honest status boundaries verified across manifest, validation.json, QA-02 pack, and report.

defects.title: Human VQ-01 visual & listening sign-off pending owner playback review
defects.baseline_evidence: Automated metrics and proxy audio QA cannot replace human viewing and listening.
defects.measured_outcome: All engineering gates G0-G9 PASS; G10 remains honestly PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW awaiting owner playback of canonical final MP4.
